newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand light.
Sales confirmed for the week to date on 1,100 head of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Monday asking prices $70.00-$71.00, bids $67.00; last sales Thursday April 17 at $68.00.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - none last week - none last year - 4,400
Wk to date - 1,100 last week - 600 last year - 8,500
